name: Damocles
axesStatus: Illustrative equal axes at a diameter estimated from brightness with an assumed albedo of 0.059; not measured.
credit: JPL Small-Body Database, absolute magnitude H = 13.23 for 5335 Damocles (1991 DA); diameter estimated by cssEarth with an assumed albedo of 0.059
shapeMeaning: Illustrative sphere at 12.4 km, estimated from JPL's absolute magnitude H = 13.23 with an assumed albedo of 0.059, the median of the seven centaurs in this batch that have a JPL-cited albedo. The size is not measured.
orientationMeaning: Illustrative ICRF north pole, arbitrary prime meridian and phase; no spin pole is published.
surfaceMeaning: Unmapped surface: the standard grid is a coordinate aid, not observed colour or terrain.
introduction: Damocles is a centaur, a small icy body orbiting the Sun among the giant planets.
card: A centaur orbiting among the giant planets.
datasetSummary: A sphere at about 12.4 km, estimated from brightness with an assumed albedo.
